projects.title: GraphBug
projects.description: AI-powered code review platform integrated with GitHub as an app. Leverages Graph RAG technology and Gemini LLM to automatically analyze pull requests, provide intelligent insights, and post code reviews. Built with Next.js 16, PostgreSQL, and supports multi-provider authentication (GitHub OAuth, Google, Magic Links).

projects.title: PropTrack
projects.description: Role-based property management platform for tenant maintenance operations. Features RBAC system for managers, technicians, and tenants with ticket escalation, daily digests, and Telegram notifications. Built with Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, Drizzle ORM, and Supabase with comprehensive e2e testing.

projects.title: Cognitive Guard
projects.description: Gamified code documentation CLI tool that calculates cognitive complexity using AST analysis and enforces documentation for complex functions via git pre-commit hooks. Features interactive TUI, achievement tracking, and support for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and more. Prevents commits for undocumented complex code.

projects.title: LLM Tasks Solver
projects.description: Autonomous agent built with LangGraph and Google Gemini that solves multi-step data science quiz tasks. Orchestrates specialized tools for web scraping, PDF processing, code execution, and API requests. Features dynamic dependency installation, rate limiting, and background task processing with FastAPI.

projects.title: HRMS System
projects.description: Comprehensive Human Resource Management System designed for enterprise operations. Includes employee management, attendance tracking, payroll processing, and HR workflows. Built with modern full-stack architecture supporting scalability and role-based access control.
